description: This file defines the HtmlWidgetRenderer class, which is responsible for rendering HTML widgets in the OFBiz framework. It includes methods for rendering boundary comments, handling whitespace, and managing widget-specific visual borders. The class is part of the widget rendering subsystem and interacts with other utility classes to facilitate HTML rendering with context-specific features.

classes.name: HtmlWidgetRenderer
classes.description: A class responsible for rendering HTML widgets, including boundary comments, visual borders, and whitespace management. It supports customization for widget comments and integrates with the OFBiz utility classes for theme and URL handling.

methods.name: setWidgetCommentsEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables the inclusion of widget boundary comments in the rendered output.

methods.name: isWidgetCommentsEnabled
methods.description: Returns whether widget boundary comments are enabled.

methods.name: appendWhitespace
methods.description: Appends predefined whitespace characters to the writer, used for formatting the rendered HTML.

methods.name: buildBoundaryComment
methods.description: Constructs an HTML comment string denoting the beginning or end of a widget boundary, including widget type and name.

methods.name: beginNamedBorder
methods.description: Generates the HTML to start a visual border around a widget based on its type, location, and current theme settings.

methods.name: endNamedBorder
methods.description: Generates the HTML to close a visual border around a widget based on its type and location.

methods.name: formatBoundaryJsComment
methods.description: Creates a JavaScript comment string for widget boundaries.

methods.name: renderBeginningBoundaryComment
methods.description: Outputs the beginning boundary comment to the writer if widget comments are enabled.

methods.name: renderEndingBoundaryComment
methods.description: Outputs the ending boundary comment to the writer if widget comments are enabled.

methods.name: getAjaxParamsFromTarget
methods.description: Extracts and formats URL query parameters from a target string for AJAX calls.
